usedFor: Speak AI analyzes audio and video, and “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive shares the output after “Media Analyzed”.

bestTemplate.name: “Media Analyzed” in Speak AI, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Once analysis finishes, the action makes a file reachable by link with a Viewer, Commenter or Editor level.

watchOut: “New Folder Created” in Speak AI is polling, so “Share File With Anyone” can run after a delay.
